recognize_zh: 黏膜潰瘍下方有一片深層浸潤：大型不典型單核細胞（核空泡狀、核仁明顯）夾雜許多嗜酸性球，大細胞CD30陽性，背景T細胞混雜，TCR-γ基因重組片段分布偏多株性，符合創傷性潰瘍性肉芽腫合併間質嗜酸性球增多（TUGSE）。
features: Ulcerated mucosal biopsy with a dense, deep polymorphous infiltrate at low power (A)
Large atypical mononuclear cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, admixed with numerous eosinophils and small lymphocytes (B)
Scattered large cells with membranous/Golgi CD30 positivity (C)
CD3 and CD2 highlight a mixed T-cell population; arrows mark large cells with variable staining (D, E)
TCR gamma PCR (Vγ10, Vγ1-8, Vγ9) shows multiple peaks in a largely polyclonal distribution (F)
describe_en: Mucosal biopsy shows surface ulceration overlying a dense, deeply extending polymorphous inflammatory infiltrate. At high power, the infiltrate consists of large atypical mononuclear cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, admixed with abundant eosinophils and small lymphocytes. The large cells are CD30 positive, and CD3 and CD2 stain a mixed T-cell population with variable expression in the large cells (arrows). T-cell receptor gamma gene rearrangement studies show multiple peaks without a single dominant clonal product in this panel. Findings are consistent with traumatic ulcerative granuloma with stromal eosinophilia (TUGSE), a reactive CD30-positive lymphoproliferation of the oral mucosa.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous/mucosal CD30-positive T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder (ALCL)
ddx.vs: ALCL shows sheets of cohesive hallmark cells with uniform strong CD30, frequent loss of pan-T antigens and a dominant clonal TCR rearrangement, unlike the polymorphous, self-limited TUGSE lesion.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD15+/PAX5 weak and CD3/CD2 negative and occur in a nodal rather than ulcerated oral mucosal setting.
LCH cells have grooved reniform nuclei and express CD1a, S100 and langerin, not CD30.
PTCL shows a monotonous atypical infiltrate with clonal TCR gene rearrangement rather than a mixed, eosinophil-rich reactive background.

stain: H&E; IHC: CD30, CD3, CD2; TCR-γ PCR
